## About
National Auto & Truck, also known as National Truck Salvage, serves the San Antonio area with quality used parts. You'll find us on New Laredo Hwy on the south side of town.
Some customers come to us after checking other yards, and some are sent our way by other shops. Reviewers say the guys are kind and helpful, take time to understand what you need, and work with you on price.
If you're driving in from out of town, call ahead and ask us to confirm your part is pulled and ready before you make the trip.

## Services
- Quality used parts: Used parts for trucks and cars, serving the San Antonio area.
- Inventory search: Search our inventory to look for the part you need.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open on Sunday?
A: No, we're closed on Sunday. We're open Monday through Saturday.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We're at 9430 New Laredo Hwy in San Antonio.
